verdict.rationale: Mercury claims it can 'Sync with Quickbooks, Xero or NetSuite, and save hours with AI-powered automations to close your books faster,' which touches accounting-integration sync, and webhooks/events APIs support real-time notifications for transactions and balances. However, the evidence never specifies whether this sync is bidirectional (i.e., writing journal entries back into the ERP) or merely a one-way export/reconciliation feed, and QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite are accounting platforms rather than full ERP systems. Missing for 10: explicit description of bidirectional data flow, real-time journal-entry posting, true ERP (SAP/Oracle-class) integration, and independent confirmation that manual journal entries are eliminated.
